title: River belief-CFR opponent multisample variance control
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: At matched terminal-node compute on the unstable state0/2/4 cohort, averaging two independent opponent-action continuations per opponent node will reduce cross-seed root-strategy TV and improve greedy agreement relative to the single-path8,192 control.
material_change: Add a default-preserving opponent_samples parameter to RiverCFRSolver and a restartable K=2 treatment runner. Stop each treatment cell at its exact single-path8k terminal-node budget and compare frozen root strategies on the same states, ranges, and seeds.
baseline: Single-path8k worst-cohort state TVs were0.446/0.525/0.553 with agreements0.194/0.097/0.132; combined control terminal budget6,530,938.
notes: Admission gates: all control SHA and state reconstruction checks pass; treatment terminal overshoot <=0.5% per cell; pooled worst-cohort TV improves by >=10% relative and greedy agreement increases; no state TV worsens by >0.05; terminal payoffs/legal probabilities remain exact. No policy distillation in this smoke.

result.summary: Nine K=2 treatment cells completed at the exact three-state single-path8k terminal-node budgets (6,535,388 actual terminals, every overshoot below0.5%). Integrity and control hashes passed, but treatment required only10,992 outer iterations versus73,728 control iterations. Pooled TV worsened from0.5080 to0.5615 (-10.52% relative improvement), agreement fell0.1412 to0.1366, and state0 TV worsened+0.0743 beyond the preregistered bound. Regret was roughly2-3x worse in every matched cell.
result.conclusion: Opponent-action K=2 averaging is less sample-efficient per terminal node because it sacrifices chance-deal/root-hand breadth. This is a direct matched-compute mechanism failure, not an undertraining result.
result.next_step: Do not test larger K. Close the current river solver implementation for target production: single-path converges too slowly on hard states and multisampling worsens compute efficiency. Return to the learned-policy portfolio and choose a mechanism that creates broad environment training hands with a trustworthy external-alignment control; retain the solver artifacts only as future infrastructure.
